$comment: This file is a JSON configuration consumed by `dartwing_ocr.validator.folder`, NOT a JSON Schema applied to another JSON file. The filename uses `.schema.json` for consistency with the other artifact contracts in this directory, but this one describes a filesystem layout. v1.3.0 (feature 022): semantic_table_truth.json is listed as an OPTIONAL per-document file (FR-005). Mandatory artifacts (source.pdf, expected.json) are unchanged from v1.2.0 (FR-006 / MI-23).
title: folder_contract
$comment_semantic_table_truth: Optional per-document sidecar consumed by the feature 022 semantic quality gate. When present, the validator validates it against semantic_table_truth.schema.json (Q41); when absent, behavior is identical to v1.2.0 (FR-005). The mandatory artifacts above are NOT changed by this addition.
$comment_evidence_packet: Unlike the other reserved_generated_filenames, evidence_packet.json is OPTIONAL at the folder level. It is produced by the 004-evidence-packet-assembly slice only when the dartwing_ocr logger is at DEBUG (or lower). The folder contract accepts both presence and absence of this file.
